    <h1>Bladimir</h1>
    <p class="subtitle">PhD Candidate · Psychological &amp; Quantitative Foundations · University of Iowa</p>

    <p> Hi, <p>
    <p>
      I am a researcher interested in the discussion, use, and teaching of quantitative methods in the social sciences. My work has two focuses: 1) the dissemination of quantitative methods (this is the most recent phase of my work, which goes hand in hand with my early experience in teaching), and 2) researching social, economic, and educational differences among students in the school system and higher education in Chile (this was the main focus of my early years of work, to which I have returned with decreasing frequency).
    </p>

    <p>
      This website serves as a repository for the work I have done over many years. I am grateful to those who have selflessly helped me achieve all of this, especially my professors and colleagues Carlos Rodríguez, Lesa Hoffman, and Ariel Aloe.
    </p>

    <div class="section-title">Research Interests</div>
    <p><strong>Quantitative Methods:</strong> Multilevel Analysis · Longitudinal Analysis · Causal Inference · Psychometrics</p>
    <p><strong>Substantive Topics:</strong> Higher Education Admission &amp; Fairness · Educational Quality &amp; School Climate · Validity Theory in Educational Measurement </p>

<div id="top-papers"></div>
<script>
fetch('https://api.semanticscholar.org/graph/v1/author/2125440399/papers?fields=title,year,citationCount,externalIds,venue&limit=100')
  .then(r => r.json())
  .then(data => {
    const top = data.data
      .filter(p => p.citationCount > 0)
      .sort((a, b) => b.citationCount - a.citationCount)
      .slice(0, 5);
    document.getElementById('top-papers').innerHTML =
      '<div class="section-title">Featured Work</div>' +
      top.map(p => {
        const link = p.externalIds && p.externalIds.DOI
          ? 'https://doi.org/' + p.externalIds.DOI : '#';
        return '<p>📄 <a href="' + link + '" target="_blank">' + p.title +
          '</a> <span style="color:#6c757d;font-size:0.85em;">' +
          (p.venue || '') + (p.year ? ' · ' + p.year : '') +
          ' · ' + p.citationCount + ' citations</span></p>';
      }).join('');
  });
</script>
